t: You're looking at Admiralty House, a Grade One listed building facing Whitehall. Today it's used for government functions and as ministerial flats. Samuel Pepys Cockerell, an English architect, designed it. Two people were born here: George Boscawen, the third Viscount Falmouth, who was an army officer and statesman and served as Captain of the Honourable Band of Gentlemen Pensioners under George the Third, and Sir Edward Buller, a Royal Navy officer who served during the American War of Independence and the Napoleonic Wars.
